surfaces.surface: Soniox Voice Dictation <-> Win32 Global Clipboard Injection Race
surfaces.vector: Soniox pastes transcribed utterances via Win32 Clipboard + SendInput(Ctrl+V) and restores prior buffer. Concurrent agent Set-Clipboard/Copy or Bitwarden copy causes cross-paste into LLM prompts or strips exclude tags on restore.
surfaces.mitigation: Invariant 8 in pretool_single_hub_guard.py hard-bans Get-Clipboard/Set-Clipboard/clip.exe/pyperclip; UI Copy buttons show Soniox-active guard; keep dictation paused while copying vault credentials.

surfaces.surface: Windows 11 Clipboard History (Win+V) & Cross-Device Cloud Sync
surfaces.vector: EnableClipboardHistory=1 archives every Soniox utterance and untagged copy into ConnectedDevicesPlatform history where any desktop app can read it.
surfaces.mitigation: Set HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Clipboard\EnableClipboardHistory=0 during sensitive legal/vault sessions or enforce CF_EXCLUDE_CLIPBOARD_CONTENT_FROM_MONITOR_PROCESSING on programmatic copies.

surfaces.surface: Bitwarden Desktop Vault <-> Agent CLI & Clipboard Window
surfaces.vector: hermes secrets / bw CLI or shell clipboard read during Bitwarden's auto-clear window leaks vault secrets into agent transcripts.
surfaces.mitigation: Invariant 7 + 8 hard-ban `hermes secrets`, `bw` CLI, AppData\Bitwarden reads, and all shell clipboard reads.

surfaces.surface: ShareX & Desktop CUA (ChatGPT cua_node / Claude computer-use) Screen & OCR Hooks
surfaces.vector: Foreground screenshots, OCR hotkeys, or CUA window focus changes can capture visible tokens/PII or redirect Soniox Ctrl+V dictation into the wrong window.
surfaces.mitigation: Invariant 9 blocks ShareX CLI uploads; keep CUA computer-use disabled while Soniox dictation is active.

surfaces.surface: Gemini App (Carbon Task Mode) Shared-Account @Google Workspace Connector Bypass
surfaces.vector: Gemini App Carbon runs server-side on hub:primary OAuth, bypassing local Windows hooks.json if prompted to edit/send/trash via @Gmail/@Drive/@Tasks.
surfaces.mitigation: Enforce Read-Only CARBON-ADVISORY-v1 Task Charter + Super-Admin Viewer-only IAM shares + HUB_09 3-Plane Epistemic Firewall; quarantine proposals in staged_manifests/carbon_advisories/.

surfaces.surface: GoogleDriveFS Virtual Mounts (G: / H:) Sync-Storm & Metadata Leak
surfaces.vector: Local writes, .gitlocks, or temp files on G:/H: sync immediately to cloud Drive and generate *(1)* conflict forks.
surfaces.mitigation: Invariant 6 blocks all write_file/edit_file/run_command mutations targeting G:\ or H:\; Drive REST API v3 dry-run only.

surfaces.surface: LLM Session Transcripts (transcript_full.jsonl) & Ephemeral CLI Shim Logs
surfaces.vector: Printing raw env vars, OAuth headers, clipboard text, or vault files writes permanent plaintext into .system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl.
surfaces.mitigation: Metadata-only Win32 probes (sequence ints & booleans only) + PreToolUse stdout secret/clipboard blocks.

surfaces.surface: Public HTTPS Verification Feed & Outbound Webhook Payloads (Spacefast / Relay)
surfaces.vector: Publishing literal emails, Windows user paths, GCP project IDs, or case party PII to public HTTPS or webhook relays exposes operational topology.
surfaces.mitigation: verify_zero_pii() deterministic gate rejects any payload with >0 emails, tokens, user paths, or case PII; public artifacts use role aliases (hub:primary, CASE-DC-507, $LO_ROOT).
